title: Companies Act, 2013 — Section 378M (Concession, etc., to be deemed to have been granted to Producer Company)

content.overview: With effect from the date of transformation, all fiscal and other concessions, licences, benefits, privileges and exemptions granted to the inter-State co-operative society in connection with its affairs and business under any law for the time being in force shall be deemed to have been granted to the Producer Company.
content.glance: Existing fiscal and other concessions of the inter-State co-operative society continue for the Producer Company from the date of transformation.
content.study: Section 378M preserves continuity of fiscal and other concessions, licences, benefits, privileges and exemptions already granted to the inter-State co-operative society. From the date of transformation they are deemed granted to the Producer Company. The section does not create new concessions; it only continues those already granted under any law then in force.

sections.heading: Rule
sections.body: From the date of transformation, existing fiscal and other concessions, licences, benefits, privileges and exemptions of the inter-State co-operative society are deemed granted to the Producer Company.

provisions.title: Concession, etc., to be deemed to have been granted to Producer Company

examples.title: Illustration — s. 378M
examples.body: A tax exemption or licence held by the inter-State co-operative society continues for the Producer Company from the date of transformation without a fresh grant.

hypotheticals.question: What is the core effect of s. 378M?
hypotheticals.analysis: It deems existing concessions and licences of the inter-State co-operative society to continue for the Producer Company from the date of transformation.

rows.right: Vesting of assets (s. 378L) or continuity of officers (s. 378N)

misconceptions.trap: Assuming the section creates new concessions.
misconceptions.correction: It only continues concessions already granted to the inter-State co-operative society.

questionsAndAnswers.question: How should s. 378M be analysed?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: I. Identify the date of transformation. II. Confirm the concession was already granted to the society. III. Conclude that it is deemed granted to the Producer Company.

examTips: Name s. 378M: Concessions deemed granted on transformation.
